summary: Undo, Redo and jumps for one history scope, as compensating commits, with Redo valid only while the scope is exactly what the last Undo left.
creates: compensating commits for the scope's top step (a look step may span several presets)

faults.when: The scope has no step left.
A gesture or control edit is open in this window.
Another window changed a field the step touched after it.

lifetime: Per history scope, while any window shows something in it.

x-friction.gap: Three separate histories exist today (look, view and lighting, character); each needs steps over sets of nodes and fields and redo cleared by any other commit in the set.
x-friction.closes: Undo over named sets of nodes and fields as an engine capability.
